about:
Mac Auto & Collision is a family-owned body shop on Circle Drive in Bessemer, run by Allen McConathy. For more than three decades, we've repaired vehicles for our neighbors in Bessemer, Hueytown, McCalla, Helena, and the greater Birmingham area.

We're not a chain. When you call, you talk to the people doing the work. We'll tell you straight what your vehicle needs, what it will cost, and how long it will take, and then we'll do exactly that.
